newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac-Kohl phone conversation courtesy call.
newsitem.headline: Chirac-Kohl phone conversation courtesy call.

text.p: A telephone conversation between French President Jacques Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Monday evening was a courtesy call which reflected the close ties between France and Germany, a Chirac aide said on Tuesday.
Chirac telephoned Kohl shortly after announcing on Monday that he planned to dissolve parliament and hold an early election.
The telephone call reflected the strength of political ties between France and Germany.
Chirac held lengthy talks with Kohl in Bonn earlier this month at which both reaffirmed their determination to launch the single European currency on time in 1999.
